锻.definition: to temper, to refine; to forge metal

mnemonic.story: Metal sections are hammered together at a forge.
Metal receives its final polish and shines as a mirror.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 長; an old man with long hair and a cane

mnemonic.story: Follow 长's long sweeping stroke like a ribbon that keeps growing longer.
Trace the two posts and top corner of 门 as an open doorway.

问.definition: to ask about, to inquire after

mnemonic.story: A mouth appears in a doorway to ask a question.

间.definition: between, among; midpoint; space, place, locality

etymology.hint: The sun 日 shining through a doorway 门

mnemonic.story: The sun peeks between two doorposts, lighting the space between them.

闻.definition: news; to hear, to smell; to make known

mnemonic.story: An ear presses against a door to hear the news outside.

阳.definition: the male principle; bright, sunny; clear, lit, open

etymology.hint: The place 阝 of the sun 日; compare 阴

mnemonic.story: A sun climbs above a hill, lighting its sunny side.

阴.definition: the female principle; dark, shaded; hidden, implicit, secret

etymology.hint: The place 阝 of the moon 月; compare 阳

mnemonic.story: A hill hides the sun; the moon rests on its shaded side.

阿.definition: an initial particle, a prefix used for names; used in transliterations

mnemonic.story: A hill opens a permission gate when you call an affectionate “Ah!” to its keeper.

附.definition: nearby; to adhere to, to attach; to rely on

mnemonic.story: A hill pays a fee to attach itself to the next hill with a bridge.
A sign shows where one hill ends and the next begins: the border.
A hill stubbornly blocks the path, setting a limit to your journey.
A hill surrounds a completely finished courtyard, sheltered from the wind.

除.definition: to eliminate, to remove, to wipe out

etymology.hint: The waste 余 produced by a city 阝

mnemonic.story: A hill sheds its surplus stones; remove what is left on the path.
All the travelers crowd onto a narrow hill ledge and recognize the danger.

陪.definition: to accompany, to be with, to keep company

mnemonic.story: A lonely spitting booth stands by a hill; sit beside it to keep it company.

随.definition: to follow, to listen to, to submit to

etymology.hint: To walk 迶 to the city 阝; to follow a path

mnemonic.story: A traveling possession rolls past a hill; follow along to see where it goes.

etymology.hint: A hand 又 trying to grasp at a bird 隹

mnemonic.story: A hand tries to catch a quick little bird; the task is difficult.

etymology.hint: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀

mnemonic.story: An overhead frame becomes a cloud; the four drops underneath fall as rain.
A broom sweeps falling rain into soft white snow.
Rain obeys an order to wash every mark away; zero marks remain.

etymology.hint: Rain 雨 needed for crops to grow

mnemonic.story: Rain soaks a dangling beard; its owner needs an umbrella.

青.definition: nature's color; blue, green, black; young

mnemonic.story: Plant shoots grow beneath a moon that paints every new leaf green.
Green grass cushions two quarreling friends; their argument fades into quiet.

etymology.hint: Two bird's wings opposed; two people back-to-back

mnemonic.story: Two rows of bars face away from each other, firmly refusing to agree.
Trace 面's outer face and the features framed inside, looking straight at you.
Leather wraps two stacked earth blocks and becomes a pair of shoes.

etymology.hint: A tongue 立 forming a sound in the mouth 日

mnemonic.story: Stand on a sun-shaped stage and release a sound that fills the sky.
Trace 页 as a hanging sheet above a shell-shaped lower edge: turn the page.

顺.definition: to submit to, to obey, to go along with

mnemonic.story: A page floats smoothly along a river without catching on anything.

etymology.hint: Hair 彡 growing on the face 页

mnemonic.story: Three beard hairs stick to a page; you must brush them off before reading.

顾.definition: to look back; to look at; to look after

mnemonic.story: A distressed page curls at the edges; look after it and smooth it gently.

顿.definition: to pause; to bow; to arrange

mnemonic.story: A camp fills a page; pause reading to rest with the campers.
A page asks “Is this true?” and becomes the question you must answer.
A scholar sketches a face on a page, carefully coloring its cheeks.
Trace 飞's wing spreading outward, ready to fly off the page.

etymology.hint: A dish of food 良 with a lid on top 人

mnemonic.story: A person follows a good smell and finds delicious food.
Food flips over in a bowl and lands as a steaming rice meal.
Food fills a wrapped package until it bulges like a full stomach.

etymology.hint: To want 我 food 饣; 我 also provides the pronunciation

mnemonic.story: Food floats just beyond me; I reach for it because I am hungry.

etymology.hint: A public 官 building where food 饣 is served; 官 also provides the pronunciation

mnemonic.story: An official offers food inside a large public building with welcoming doors.

etymology.hint: A deer's head 自 adorned with antlers 丷

mnemonic.story: Two horns crown yourself, making your head the leader of the parade.

etymology.hint: A herb 禾 with a sweet 甘 smell

mnemonic.story: The sun warms grain until a fragrant smell rises into the air.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 馬, a horse galloping to the left

mnemonic.story: Trace 马's bent head, folded legs and long back as a galloping horse.

验.definition: to examine, to inspect, to test, to verify

mnemonic.story: All the riders inspect a horse and test whether its saddle fits.
A strange horse grows a comfortable saddle; climb on and ride.

骗.definition: to cheat, to defraud, to swindle

mnemonic.story: A flat cardboard horse deceives a rider who expected a real one.
A lid caps a tower of mouths and windows, stacked so high you crane your neck.
A curled head leads a field of scales above one tail line: a fish swims past.
A fish and a sheep arrive at a picnic with fresh food from water and field.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 烏, a bird

mnemonic.story: Trace 鸟's beak, eye and folded wing, then imagine the bird taking flight.

etymology.hint: Another 又 kind of bird 鸟

mnemonic.story: A hand scatters grain for a bird; the bird clucks like a chicken.

etymology.hint: Hemp plants 林 growing in a greenhouse 广

mnemonic.story: Woods crowd beneath a shelter; squeeze through until your arms feel numb.
Trace 黄 as a broad harvest basket with little feet, overflowing with yellow grain.

etymology.hint: A man's face blacked by soot from a fire 灬

mnemonic.story: Trace 黑 as a cooking pot above four fire dots; soot turns the pot black.

鼓.definition: drum; to beat, to strike; to rouse

mnemonic.story: A support holds a drum upright while you beat its booming rhythm.
Yourself offers a gift to the air and sniffs it with your nose.
Teeth obey an order to line up and tell the person's age.
